h:
此 ComfyUI 工作流程用于测试和选择最适合您的图像的预处理器/控制网络。只需添加图像（或单帧）并分析结果即可。它使用辅助控制网、marigold 深度、SoftEdgePlus，并添加了一个 automask 节点。

*第一次运行工作流程时，它会自动下载所需的模型。目前，“Zoe_Depth_Anything”模型存在错误链接。如果你遇到一个巨大的错误。从 HuggingFace 下载模型这里并将其放入：

...\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\comfyui_controlnet_aux\ckpts\LiheYoung\Depth-Anything\checkpoints_metric_depth\depth_anything_metric_depth_indoor.pt

o.en:
This ComfyUI workflow is used to test and pick which preprocessors/controlnets will work best for your images. Simply add a image (or single frame) and analyze the results. It uses the auxiliary controlnets, marigold depth, SoftEdgePlus, and threw in a automask node.

*When running the workflow for the first time, It will auto download the models it needs. Currently there is a bad link for the "Zoe_Depth_Anything" model. If you get a giant error. Download the model from HuggingFacehereand put it in:

...\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\comfyui_controlnet_aux\ckpts\LiheYoung\Depth-Anything\checkpoints_metric_depth\depth_anything_metric_depth_indoor.pt
